description: This file contains the implementation of the Register controller for user registration functionality in an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It manages rendering the registration page, handling form submissions, validating input, and creating new customer accounts.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Controller class managing user registration process including page rendering and form handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the registration form page, setting up breadcrumbs, language strings, configuration options, and including necessary components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the submission of the registration form, validates input, creates a new customer account if validation passes, and handles post-registration logic like login and redirection.
